sources.title: DeepSeek R1 — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: DeepSeek R1 is an open-source reasoning model with 671B parameters (37B active) released under MIT license. It achieves performance comparable to OpenAI o1 while maintaining fully open reasoning tokens. The model is available as open weights for commercial use and distillation.
